standard_prerequisites: The etale pullback formula for principal divisors, and the principle that a cycle equality may be checked after pulling back along a surjective etale morphism
Flat pullback and proper pushforward of cycles, the compatibility of flat pullback with proper pushforward (projection formula) and the composition of flat pullbacks
The scheme case of the statement, and the multiplicity of an irreducible component in a cycle together with the scheme theoretic image of a component
core_obligations: Observe that every irreducible component of X dominates Y, so the restricted rational function is defined in each summand

Choose a scheme V with a surjective etale morphism to Y and a scheme U with a surjective etale morphism to the fibre product of V and X over Y, and note that because the map from U to X is surjective etale it suffices to prove the cycle equality after pulling back along it

Rewrite the pullback of the divisor of g to V as the sum of the divisors of the restrictions to the components of V using the etale formula, then apply the projection formula for flat pullback of a proper pushforward to rewrite the pullback to U as a sum indexed by the components of the fibre products with U

Apply the scheme case of the statement to the projection from the fibre product of a component of V with U to that component, obtaining the formula as a sum over the components of U, and record that each such component is a component of U and lies over exactly one component of V

Identify the multiplicities: the multiplicity of a component of U in the fibre product equals the multiplicity of the image component of X, using the equality of flat pullbacks of the fundamental class and the etale pullback statement

Pull back the right hand side of the statement along the etale map to U, rewrite each summand by the etale formula, and compare with the expression obtained above, the components matching exactly by their image in X
proof_roadmap: Check dominance of the components and set up a scheme V etale over Y and a scheme U etale over the fibre product
Compute the pullback of the divisor to U in two ways using the etale formula and the projection formula
Apply the scheme case to the projection from the fibre product to a component of V and bookkeep the components of U
Match multiplicities through the equality of flat pullbacks of the fundamental class and conclude by comparing the two expressions
difficulty_reason: The counted conclusion is the flat pullback formula for principal divisors with multiplicities at source lines 2038-2050, label lemma-prepare-flat-pullback-rational-equivalence, whose proof occupies source lines 2052-2131. The proof is a two-stage reduction that never works on the general space directly: it descends along a surjective etale map to a scheme U sitting over a fibre product of a scheme V etale over Y with X, computes the pullback of the divisor to U in two independent ways, and then matches the two expressions term by term. The nontrivial parts are the bookkeeping of which component of U lies over which component of V and which component of X, and the identification of the multiplicities in the fibre product with the multiplicities in X through the equality of flat pullbacks of the fundamental class. The counted statement records neither the cover nor the multiplicity identification.
